WHY FIBER DOORS

Everything wood doors struggle with, solved.

Modern fiber doors give you the warm look of wood without the damp, termites and constant repair.

01

Waterproof

Moisture and humidity won't swell or warp the door. Ideal for bathrooms and entrances.

02

Termite Proof

No wood, no termites. Stays clean and solid year after year.

03

Strong & Light

Durable build that is easier to handle and fit than heavy timber.

04

Low Maintenance

No repeated polishing or repainting. Wipe clean and you're done.

OUR PRODUCTS

Fiber doors, engineered properly.

Our doors are engineered to resist moisture, termites, weather exposure and daily wear.

01 · FIBERGLASS CORE

Each door uses 450 GSM fiberglass sheets combined with premium-grade resin (P1) and a rigid wooden frame.

02 · DUAL-LAYER GEL COAT

A smooth, UV-resistant, weather-protected surface finish.

03 · REINFORCED FRAME

Fiberglass mat layers and resin coatings bond into a rigid, impact-resistant structure, with an inner wooden frame to securely support hinges, locks and hardware.

04 · CHOICE OF CORE

PU foam for lightweight thermal and sound insulation, or solid wooden filling for a heavier, more solid feel. Pressing technology ensures maximum bonding strength.

ABOUT US

8 years of building doors that last.

K2 Fiber Doors & Traders is a door manufacturer and trader based in Gujranwala, Punjab, Pakistan.

OUR STORY

Modern design with real durability.

With 8 years of experience, we have built our name on premium fiber doors that combine modern design with long-term performance.

We use advanced technology and high-grade materials: 450 GSM fiberglass sheets, premium-grade P1 resin and a rigid wooden frame, finished with a dual-layer gel coat. Every door is engineered to resist moisture, termites, weather exposure and daily wear.

Our range covers Melamine, PVC, Fiber and Malaysian doors in multiple finishes, with designs from clean and modern to richly carved.
